object.description: Setup: outdoors, permissions granted, battery optimisation left at its default. Steps: 1. Start and walk 250 m. 2. Lock the phone and keep walking 250 m for about 3 min. 3. Unlock the phone and read distance and elapsed time. Expected: Elapsed time has advanced by the real time passed plus or minus 2 s and distance has increased by at least 200 m during the locked period.
